output_list.code: function mint(address receiver, uint amount) onlyMintAgent public { totalSupply = totalSupply + amount; balances[receiver] = balances[receiver] + amount; Transfer(0, receiver, amount); }
output_list.reason: The mint function is only callable by the mintAgent. The mintAgent can mint tokens at will, bypassing the normal token holder flow. This can be used to inflate the token supply. The mintAgent can be set to any address, including the token contract itself, making it easy for a malicious contract to mint tokens at will.
